issues.title: Missing GWT Acceptance Criteria for Sub-modules
issues.why: While the overview has a smoke harness AC, individual modules (Database, Config, Progress) lack specific Given/When/Then criteria and Verifies clauses.
issues.fix: Add a 'Verification' section to each markdown file with at least one GWT scenario and a specific test command.

issues.title: Dangling References to External Specs
issues.why: The overview references '20-terminal-output-design.md' and '14-date-formatting.md' which are mentioned but their full content is not provided in the context.
issues.fix: Ensure all referenced spec files are either included in the bundle or their core requirements are summarized in the overview.

issues.title: Concurrency and Race Conditions Unaddressed
issues.why: The 'Local Database' and 'Progress Tracking' modules do not specify thread-safety requirements for the global logger or DB handle.
issues.fix: Add a constraint in 10-database.md and 16-verbose-logging.md requiring a sync.Once or Mutex for global instance access.
